theme: An open Sunday in St. Pete, with a few overdue bookings worth clearing.
greeting: The day's yours once the morning review's behind you, Dan. The girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete, and a couple of time-sensitive bookings have been waiting for exactly a quiet stretch like this.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since Sep 14 and flagged p1: book a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week now. It's the hardest rental in that market over the holiday, and the only six-seater in Maine once the Pathfinder heads south.

needsAttention.title: Term life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: Your half is the shopping: three term quotes, with coverage amount and term length still to pin down. Due Sep 25, and the gap it closes is four kids and no coverage.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive hotel night
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5-18 Portland to St Pete drive needs its one hotel night booked once dates are set. Overdue since Sep 25, and the window is now weeks out.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: 15-min board sweep, owner and date on everything

flagged.title: FICO balance alert
flagged.detail: myFICO flags your AMEX monthly balance ticked up. Automated, but worth a glance.

flagged.title: Care.com applicants
flagged.detail: A new message from Lynsey P. and an application from Kindal F. on your posted job.

flagged.title: ICGN site relaunch
flagged.detail: The new ICGN website is live; member login needs a fresh setup for member-only content.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and newsletters: Foglinen, OXO, Field Company, Foreign Affairs, Noahpinion, and the usual promotions.

recipe.title: Warm beet soup
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the season brings in from the garden and market.

tasks.title: Reschedule the passport appt for the 4 girls

acts.line: The 15-minute review with Mike is done, and the morning opens up from there.
Nothing sits on the calendar, so the afternoon is entirely yours.
A settled evening at home with the four of them.
